scripts.postinstall: npm --prefix Frontend install && npm --prefix Backend/node install
scripts.dev: dotenv -e .env -- concurrently -n front,node,go -c cyan,green,yellow "npm --prefix Frontend run dev" "npm --prefix Backend/node run dev" "go -C Backend/go run ."
scripts.build: npm --prefix Frontend run build && go -C Backend/go build -o bin/server .
